analysis.executiveSummary: Big Balder Brand (Champion Favorite) proposes sending QB Jaxson Dart, a 2029 1st, a 2027 2nd, and WR Jalen Coker to DMV Fantasy (Retooling) for elite QB Jayden Daniels and WR Khalil Shakir. Upgrading starting QB from Dart (82.1 C-AVI) to Daniels (95.8 C-AVI) adds +13.7 C-AVI to Big Balder Brand's starting lineup in a 16-team league without sacrificing any existing starting skill players. However, surrendering both a future 1st and 2nd round pick alongside a 23-year-old starting QB and a newly extended WR in Jalen Coker represents an overpayment. AVI recommends revising the proposal by removing the 2027 2nd pick, preserving draft capital liquidity while maintaining strong acceptance probability for Retooling DMV Fantasy.

verdict.rationale: Acquiring Jayden Daniels raises Big Balder Brand's starting QB position to elite tier (+13.7 C-AVI), directly advancing their championship objective. However, sending both the 2029 1st and 2027 2nd alongside Jaxson Dart and Jalen Coker creates an unnecessary draft capital premium. Trimming the 2027 2nd pick optimizes trade share while keeping acceptance probability high with Retooling DMV Fantasy.
